parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true and reside in the same test file, Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift, within the Artwork package. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.714 indicates structural overlap, the two methods — fetchesCachedArtworkWithoutReleaseTitle (line 593) and skipsEmptyReleaseTitle (line 649) — encode distinct behavioural scenarios for CacheCoordinatorArtworkTests: one asserts that cached artwork is returned when a release title is absent, the other asserts that an empty release title causes the cache lookup to be skipped. Collapsing them would obscure the intent of each test case and reduce diagnostic clarity on failure. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters are classified as intentional duplication.
